about: Researched SEST items that are NOT shipped: the check refuted the proposal, decided to leave the price unknown, or the mapping would copy a blank author entry. build_pack.py lists them, with their candidate figures, under Gaps in docs/combat-costs/cost-list.md. Shipped prices live in mappings.json.
